frames.shows: スキルリスト one frame BEFORE the ▷ arrow's click registers. Footer reads スキルポイント : 16; サンクチュアリ reads ◁ 7 / 7 ▷; every raisable cell shows its ◁ ▷ arrows.

frames.video_title: ラグナロクオンライン　スタートアップガイド(ウィンドウ編 その１)
frames.shows: The very next frame. THREE changes at once: the footer reads スキルポイント : 15 / 16, サンクチュアリ's level digit turns RED, and every stepper's ◁ ▷ arrows disappear window-wide. Cut-verified — two independent UI-free regions differ by 0.20 and 0.29 across this pair.
frames.licence: Private study. Frame grabbed from a publicly published video for non-commercial research into UI behaviour; not redistributed as media. Ragnarok Online (C) Gravity Co., Ltd. & Lee Myoungjin / GungHo Online Entertainment.

frames.video_title: ラグナロクオンライン　スタートアップガイド(ウィンドウ編 その１)
frames.shows: The サンクチュアリ cell in five states, 6x, stacked top to bottom: (1) idle 00:08:58.500 — BLUE icon frame, ◁ 7 / 7 ▷; (2) hover 00:09:00.533 — frame turns PINK, icon still bright, arrows still there; (3) PRESSED 00:09:00.667 — the icon tile DARKENS while the button is held; (4) allocated 00:09:00.800 — icon bright again, level digit RED, arrows gone; (5) pointer away 00:09:07.000 — frame blue again, reading ◁ 7 / 8 ▷ with the 7 still red. Press-on and press-off are each a single cut-verified frame (UI-free region 0.01 and 0.29).
frames.licence: Private study. Frame grabbed from a publicly published video for non-commercial research into UI behaviour; not redistributed as media. Ragnarok Online (C) Gravity Co., Ltd. & Lee Myoungjin / GungHo Online Entertainment.

frames.video_title: ラグナロクオンライン　スタートアップガイド(ウィンドウ編 その１)
frames.shows: The キリエエリソン cell — a DIFFERENT skill, far from the pointer — at 00:09:00.733, 00:09:00.767 and 00:09:06.100, 6x. Its value stays 7 / 7 throughout, but its arrows vanish in the same frame the point is spent and return when the pending state is discarded. The arrows are a window-wide mode, not a per-cell hover affordance.
frames.licence: Private study. Frame grabbed from a publicly published video for non-commercial research into UI behaviour; not redistributed as media. Ragnarok Online (C) Gravity Co., Ltd. & Lee Myoungjin / GungHo Online Entertainment.

frames.licence: Private study. Frame grabbed from a publicly published video for non-commercial research into UI behaviour; not redistributed as media. Ragnarok Online (C) Gravity Co., Ltd. & Lee Myoungjin / GungHo Online Entertainment.

frames.video_title: ラグナロクオンライン　スタートアップガイド(ウィンドウ編 その１)
frames.shows: After `cancel` on that dialog: the footer is back to スキルポイント : 16, サンクチュアリ back to a black 7 / 7, and every stepper's arrows are back. Cancel DISCARDS the pending allocation rather than returning to it. The revert lands in one cut-verified frame at 00:09:06.033 (UI-free region 0.00).
frames.licence: Private study. Frame grabbed from a publicly published video for non-commercial research into UI behaviour; not redistributed as media. Ragnarok Online (C) Gravity Co., Ltd. & Lee Myoungjin / GungHo Online Entertainment.
